design_lineage.note: V2 retains the historical Underworld gameplay identity (wounds as resources, vitality drain, sacrifice/discard cost, hostile transfer and defeat pressure) while adopting the approved Grave Pact names and two-action-slot Creature contract.

visual_rules.printing_rule: Printing finish is cosmetic and never changes gameplay identity or rules.

cards.name: Grimling

ability.name: Little Siphon
ability.text: Once during your turn, if Grimling has damage, drain 10 vitality from the opposing Vanguard and heal Grimling by the actual HP damage drained.

cards.artwork: Small skeletal shadow-beast with green soul-fire eyes in a ruined grave city.

cards.name: Cryptjaw

ability.name: Blood Interest
ability.text: The first time during your turn Cryptjaw receives 10 or more damage from one of your own card effects, its next attack that turn deals 20 more damage.

attack_1.name: Shadow Bite
attack_1.text: After damage, if the target remains in play, drain 20 vitality from it and heal Cryptjaw by the actual HP damage drained.

cards.artwork: Long-jawed skeletal grave hound wreathed in necrotic teal flame.

cards.name: Thanavor — Debtbound Sovereign

ability.name: Sovereign Debt
ability.text: Once during your turn, choose 1 damaged friendly Underworld creature. Move up to 30 damage from it to Debtbound Sovereign. If at least 20 damage moved, draw 1 card.

attack_1.name: Final Collection
attack_1.text: As an additional declaration cost, discard 2 cards from your hand or place 40 damage on Debtbound Sovereign. After damage, if the target remains in play, drain 60 vitality from the opposing Vanguard and heal Debtbound Sovereign by the actual HP damage drained. If Debtbound Sovereign has at least 40 damage, you may move up to 40 damage from it to another opposing creature.

cards.artwork: Crowned antlered death sovereign, bone-gold regalia, chains and spectral green fire above a black citadel.

cards.name: Mire Imp

ability.name: Grave Nibble
ability.text: When played from hand into an empty Reserve space during your Build phase, if another friendly creature has damage, you may move 10 damage from that creature to Mire Imp.

cards.artwork: Tiny horned imp emerging from black marsh water with soul-fire wisps.

cards.name: Graveshade

attack_2.name: Wraith Mark
attack_2.text: If one of your creatures was defeated since the end of your previous turn, this attack deals 20 more damage.

cards.artwork: Hooded wraith creature with clawed hands and torn teal spirit-cloth.

cards.name: Requiem Lord

attack_2.name: Grave Covenant
attack_2.text: After damage, if Requiem Lord has at least 40 damage, you may move up to 40 damage from Requiem Lord to the opposing Vanguard.

cards.artwork: Tall skeletal necromancer-lord with antlered crown, staff and grave-green aura.

cards.name: Bone Lantern Hound

ability.name: Buried Sip
ability.text: Once during your turn, if the opposing Vanguard has damage, drain 20 vitality from it and heal Bone Lantern Hound by the actual HP damage drained.

cards.artwork: Bone hound carrying a glowing soul lantern between its ribs.

cards.name: Hollow Revenant

ability.name: Hollow Price
ability.text: The first time during your turn you discard a card from your hand as a cost, gain Shield 20 on Hollow Revenant.

attack_1.name: Toll Charge
attack_1.text: You may discard 1 card from your hand when this attack is declared. If you do, this attack deals 30 more damage.

cards.artwork: Armored hollow knight-beast with empty glowing rib cage and ruined graveplate.

cards.name: Mourningray

ability.name: Grief Current
ability.text: The first time during your turn one of your friendly creatures is actually healed, you may place 10 damage on Mourningray. If you do, draw 1 card.

attack_1.name: Black Wake
attack_1.text: If Mourningray has at least 30 damage, drain 20 vitality from the target after damage.

cards.artwork: Ghostly manta-ray spirit gliding over grave mist and drowned ruins.

cards.name: Coffincrow

attack_2.name: Last Feather
attack_2.text: If a creature was defeated during this turn, this attack deals 20 more damage.

cards.artwork: Black skeletal crow perched on a coffin marker with teal ghost feathers.

cards.name: Bloodbasilisk

ability.name: Paid in Blood
ability.text: Once during your turn, you may place 20 damage on Bloodbasilisk. If you do, choose 1 opposing creature and drain 40 vitality from it; heal Bloodbasilisk by the actual HP damage drained.

attack_1.name: Red Ledger
attack_1.text: If Bloodbasilisk received damage from one of your own card effects during this turn, this attack deals 20 more damage.

cards.artwork: Massive basilisk of black bone and red-veined soul crystal in a burial chamber.

cards.name: Underworld Essence
cards.artwork: Necrotic teal crystal-flame suspended above black stone.

cards.name: Siphon Essence
cards.text: The first time during each of your turns the attached Underworld creature drains vitality, increase the heal from that drain by up to 10. This bonus cannot recursively trigger another drain.
cards.artwork: Twin soul streams being drawn into a black-green essence shard.

cards.name: Debt Essence
cards.text: When attached from hand to a damaged friendly Underworld creature, you may place 10 additional damage on that creature; if you do, draw 1 card.
cards.artwork: Chained essence gem inscribed with a glowing debt sigil.

cards.name: Grave Essence
cards.text: When the attached creature is defeated and this Essence is discarded by the defeat flow, choose 1 damaged friendly Underworld creature and Heal 20 damage from it.
cards.artwork: Gravestone-shaped crystal opening into a spectral green vortex.

cards.name: Collector Vey
cards.text: Choose 1 damaged friendly Underworld creature. Move up to 30 damage from it to another friendly creature. If at least 20 damage moved, draw 1 card.
cards.artwork: Masked debt collector carrying chains and a green-lit ledger through a grave market.

cards.name: Ferryman Korr
cards.text: Choose up to 1 Underworld Creature card in your discard that was defeated earlier in the match and put it on the bottom of your deck. Then draw 2 cards.
cards.artwork: Spectral ferryman steering a bone skiff through black water.

cards.name: Mourner Isa
cards.text: If one of your creatures was defeated during the opponent's previous turn, draw 3 cards, then discard 1 card.
cards.artwork: Veiled mourner beneath green candles and hanging grave bells.

cards.name: Blood Contract
cards.text: Choose 1 friendly Underworld creature. Place 20 damage on it; then attach up to 1 Basic Underworld Essence from your discard to that creature. This is additional to the normal manual Essence attachment.
cards.artwork: Glowing pact parchment sealed with red-black wax and spectral chains.

cards.name: Debt Ledger
cards.text: Discard 1 card from your hand. If you do, choose 1 opposing creature with damage and deal Damage 40 effect damage to it.
cards.artwork: Ancient ledger book with chained pages and tally marks glowing teal.

cards.name: Wound Exchange
cards.text: Choose 1 damaged friendly Underworld creature and 1 opposing creature. Move up to 60 damage from the friendly creature to the opposing creature. You may play this only if at least 30 damage can move.
cards.artwork: Two spectral vessels connected by a glowing blood-red and teal transfer chain.

cards.name: Black Chain
cards.text: The first time during each of your turns the attached Underworld creature drains vitality, its next attack that turn deals Damage +20.
cards.artwork: Black iron chain threaded through green soul-fire links.

cards.name: Soul Ledger
cards.text: The first time during each opponent turn another friendly creature is defeated, gain Shield 20 on the attached Underworld creature.
cards.artwork: Heavy black-gold ledger relic with a glowing soul trapped in the cover.

cards.name: Hollow Crypt
cards.text: The first time during each player's own turn that player places damage on one of their own creatures as a card cost, that player may draw 1 card, then discard 1 card.
cards.artwork: Cathedral-sized crypt with green gates, bone towers and a moonlit grave city.

approval_gate.next_if_approved: translate this design candidate into exact sb-tcg-card-v0.2 effect opcodes, validate all owner capabilities, then prepare the Fairy V2 package using the same contract
